questions.question: To drive
questions.explanation: 'Ajaa' means to drive a vehicle.

questions.question: To start / begin
questions.explanation: 'Aloittaa' is the transitive verb meaning to start or initiate something.

questions.question: Degree (e.g., temperature)
questions.explanation: 'Aste' means degree (used for angles or temperature like Celsius).

questions.question: Sun
questions.explanation: 'Aurinko' means the sun.

questions.question: To prevent / block
questions.explanation: Corrected spelling from 'estiä' to 'estää', which means to prevent or block.

questions.question: Overalls (student or work jumpsuits)
questions.explanation: 'Haalarit' means overalls or coveralls, very popular among Finnish university students.

questions.question: To fetch / apply for
questions.explanation: 'Hakea' means to fetch, pick up, or apply for (e.g., hakea työtä).

questions.question: Skirt
questions.explanation: 'Hame' means skirt.

questions.question: Hobby
questions.explanation: 'Harrastus' means a hobby or pastime activity.

questions.question: To ski
questions.explanation: 'Hiihtää' specifically means cross-country skiing.

questions.question: Elevator / Lift
questions.explanation: 'Hissi' means elevator or lift.

questions.question: Trousers / Pants
questions.explanation: 'Housut' means pants or trousers (always plural).

questions.question: To celebrate / party
questions.explanation: 'Juhlia' means to celebrate or party.

questions.question: Thing / Story
questions.explanation: 'Juttu' is a colloquial word for a thing, matter, or story.

questions.question: To fish
questions.explanation: 'Kalastaa' means to fish.

questions.question: Spring (season)
questions.explanation: 'Kevät' means spring.

questions.question: Size
questions.explanation: 'Koko' means size (e.g., Vaatekoko = clothing size).

questions.question: Gift / Present
questions.explanation: 'Lahja' means a gift or present.

questions.question: To count / lower / ski downhill
questions.explanation: 'Laskea' can mean to count, to lower, or to go downhill (laskea mäkeä).

questions.question: Nickname
questions.explanation: 'Lempinimi' translates directly to nickname.

questions.question: Too / Too much
questions.explanation: 'Liian' is used before adjectives (too big), 'liikaa' is used with partitive nouns (too much money).

questions.question: Dirty
questions.explanation: 'Likainen' means dirty or soiled.

questions.question: To end / finish (by itself)
questions.explanation: 'Loppua' means to end or finish (intransitive, e.g., Kurssi loppuu = The course ends).

questions.question: Snow
questions.explanation: 'Lumi' means snow.

questions.question: Credit / Trust
questions.explanation: 'Luotto' means credit (as in luottokortti = credit card) or trust.

questions.question: To assume / think wrongly
questions.explanation: 'Luulla' means to assume, suppose, or believe something that might not be a fact.

questions.question: Contactless payment
questions.explanation: 'Lähimaksu' means contactless payment / tap-and-go payment.

questions.question: To find
questions.explanation: 'Löytää' means to find or discover something.

questions.question: To travel
questions.explanation: 'Matkustaa' means to travel.

questions.question: Fashion
questions.explanation: 'Muoti' means fashion.

questions.question: Amount / Quantity
questions.explanation: 'Määrä' means amount, quantity, or volume.

questions.question: To look like / show / seem
questions.explanation: 'Näyttää' means to look like, seem, or to show something to someone.

questions.question: Program / Show / Agenda
questions.explanation: 'Ohjelma' means program, TV show, or a schedule.

questions.question: To take
questions.explanation: 'Ottaa' means to take.

questions.question: To shine (sun) / To bake (eggs/pancakes)
questions.explanation: 'Paistaa' is used for the sun shining (Aurinko paistaa) or frying/baking food.

questions.question: Shirt
questions.explanation: 'Paita' means a shirt or a t-shirt.

questions.question: Freezing weather / Frost
questions.explanation: 'Pakkanen' refers to sub-zero temperatures / freezing weather.

questions.question: Mirror
questions.explanation: 'Peili' means mirror.

questions.question: Dark (absence of light)
questions.explanation: 'Pimeä' means dark (e.g., Pimeä huone = a dark room / winter is pimeä).

questions.question: Beanie / Winter hat
questions.explanation: 'Pipo' means a beanie or knit cap.

questions.question: To fall / drop
questions.explanation: 'Pudota' means to fall down or drop accidentally.

questions.question: To dress / put on clothes
questions.explanation: 'Pukea' means to put on clothes or dress someone.

questions.question: Tree / Wood
questions.explanation: 'Puu' means tree, or wood as a material.

questions.question: Garden
questions.explanation: 'Puutarha' means garden.

questions.question: Tires (car wheels)
questions.explanation: 'Renkaat' means tires (plural of rengas).

questions.question: To rain / snow
questions.explanation: 'Sataa' means to rain or snow (e.g., Sataa vettä = It rains, Sataa lunta = It snows).

questions.question: To stand
questions.explanation: 'Seisoa' means to stand.

questions.question: To fit / suit / match
questions.explanation: 'Sopia' means to fit or suit someone (e.g., Tämä paita sopii minulle = This shirt fits me).

questions.question: Suitable / Fitting
questions.explanation: 'Sopiva' is the adjective meaning suitable, appropriate, or of right size.

questions.question: Gloves / Fingered gloves
questions.explanation: 'Sormikkaat' means fingered gloves (from sormi = finger).

questions.question: To try on (clothes)
questions.explanation: 'Sovittaa' means to try on clothes for size or to reconcile.

questions.question: Autumn / Fall
questions.explanation: 'Syksy' means autumn.

questions.question: To save / economize
questions.explanation: 'Säästää' means to save money, time, or energy.

questions.question: Behind
questions.explanation: 'Takana' means behind. It requires the preceding noun to be in the Genitive case (e.g., auton takana = behind the car).

questions.question: Coat / Jacket
questions.explanation: 'Takki' means a coat or jacket.

questions.question: Winter
questions.explanation: 'Talvi' means winter.

questions.question: To text / send an SMS
questions.explanation: 'Tekstata' means to send a text message.

questions.question: Subscription / Order
questions.explanation: 'Tilaus' means an order or subscription (e.g., lehden tilaus = magazine subscription).

questions.question: Product / Item
questions.explanation: 'Tuote' means product.

questions.question: Wind (noun)
questions.explanation: 'Tuuli' is the noun meaning wind.

questions.question: To be windy / blow
questions.explanation: 'Tuulla' is the verb meaning to blow/be windy (used as: Ulkona tuulee = It's windy outside).

questions.question: Thunderstorm / Thunder
questions.explanation: 'Ukkonen' means thunder or thunderstorm.

questions.question: Although / Even though / For example
questions.explanation: 'Vaikka' means although, even if, or can be used informally as 'for example'.

questions.question: To choose / select
questions.explanation: 'Valita' means to choose, select, or elect.

questions.question: Bright / Well-lit
questions.explanation: 'Valoisa' means bright or filled with light (e.g., Valoisa asunto = A bright apartment).

questions.question: Storage / Warehouse
questions.explanation: 'Varasto' means storage, stock, or warehouse.

questions.question: Opposite / Antonym
questions.explanation: 'Vastakohta' means the opposite or contrast of something.

questions.question: Next to / Beside
questions.explanation: 'Vieressä' means next to. It requires the preceding noun to be in the Genitive case (e.g., kaupan vieressä = next to the shop).

questions.question: Seasons
questions.explanation: 'Vuodenajat' means seasons of the year (plural of vuodenaika).

questions.question: Up / Upstairs / Above
questions.explanation: 'Ylhäällä' means up, high up, or upstairs (static location).
